Lina (ENG): Cutting RC build: rc-2026-03-20-1. artifact redwood-serve:rc-2026-03-20-1 sha=sha256:abcd1234. Target promo window 2026-03-20 18:00-19:00 UTC. Includes runtime patch (v2.3.1) + KV cache tweak. Requesting quick sign-off (QA, SRE, PM) so we can schedule promotion.

Omar (PM): ack. PM ok with window. Quick Q: any DB or schema changes that require migrations or backfill?

Lina (ENG): No DB changes. It's purely serving runtime + cache behavior. Should be no data migrations.

Maria (QA): smoke on staging ✅. Ran regen eval on 10k prompts: quality drift within threshold (mean change <0.4 BLEU). Small delta on a couple prompts but acceptable. I'll add notes to release-notes doc.

Sarah (SRE): On SRE side: propose canary schedule + automated rollback thresholds. Suggested policy: canary 5% for 15m, 25% for 30m, then 100%. Rollback triggers: 5xx >2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >300ms sustained for 5m OR error budget burn >30% in 15m. Dashboards to watch: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/rc-rollout (grafana). Also we should pin the artifact to sha before promo.

deploy-bot: RC build created: redwood-serve:rc-2026-03-20-1 sha=sha256:abcd1234. Use /deploy promote to schedule.

Lina (ENG): Adding the rollout command here so ops can copy:
```
/deploy promote rc-2026-03-20-1 \
  --canary 5:15m,25:30m,100:rest \
  --pin sha256:abcd1234 \
  --watch-metrics p95:300ms,5xx:2% \
  --rollback-thresholds "5xx>2%:5m,p95>300ms:5m" \
  --change-window 2026-03-20T18:00Z/2026-03-20T19:00Z
```

sre-oncall: I'll be monitoring during the window. Oncall escalation: page me + call the SRE runner if automation doesn't rollback within 3 minutes of threshold. My emergency rollback play: pin traffic to fallback model variant text-1-lite + pin nodes to previous runtime.

Omar (PM): PM sign-off: :thumbsup: No feature flags. Confirmed release notes mention: runtime bump, cache tweak, fallback variant configured. Maria please paste the release-notes link when done.

Maria (QA): Release notes updated: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-20-rc1. Note includes QA eval summary and known minor diffs.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: rc-2026-03-20-1 at 2026-03-20T18:00:00Z. Canary plan queued. I will post progress updates to this thread. :rocket:

Sarah (SRE): If we see token cost spike >20% vs baseline for 10m, we'll divert traffic to fallback and open incident in #incidents. I'll shout in ops channel if thresholds start trending.

Lina (ENG): Good plan. Also adding fallback routing rule in case of capacity: route policy fallback -> text-1-lite (pre-verified). If automation fails, we will manual rollback and pin previous runtime (sha256:prev9876).

Lina (ENG): @compliance-bot please record RC metadata (artifact sha, canary plan, window, approvers).

compliance-bot: Recorded RC metadata: rc-2026-03-20-1, sha256:abcd1234, approvers [Maria (QA), Sarah (SRE), Omar (PM)], change-window 2026-03-20T18:00Z/2026-03-20T19:00Z. Audit id: AUD-20260320-77.

Lina (ENG): thanks everyone — will push the scheduled promote. If anything changes I'll update here.

Sarah (SRE): copy. I'll be watching p95/5xx/error-budget and ready to roll back.

Omar (PM): thanks team, glhf.
